sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MiniCPM5-2B uses the standard LlamaForCausalLM architecture, so mainstream inference engines can load it directly: no custom kernels, no model-code fork. For step-by-step deployment and fine-tuning instructions, use the GitHub cookbooks below. Agent Skills are linked as GitHub resources for users working with Cursor / Claude Code style coding ...

sources.title: Teardown: AI exploded-view diagrams and parts lists from a photo
sources.snippet: Photograph any object and Teardown's AI builds a labeled exploded-view diagram and a parts list sourced from real manuals, datasheets and teardowns. Try it free.
